notes.title: Workshop and mod support Update!
notes.notes:
Hello Dino Slayers!

This update is rolling out a base for workshop support and foundation for various customizations for Dinosaur Hunt. 

From the in-game menu you can install Uncle Joe AK47 skin:

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1473493840

In this patch you you can also add your own very custom AK47 skin, here is how to do it:

In the folder where the game is installed, next to executable there is a folder called ..._DATA, inside you will another folder called StreamingAssets.

If you copy an image file there and name it: ak47.png 

It will be used as a skin for your AK47 in the game.  

Stay tuned as more updates are coming!

May the shotgun be with you, 

ANPA.US

notes.title: Update #680
notes.notes:
Hey All

This update is quite big c.a. 2GB, mainly because of updated graphics features and upgraded core engine, on top of that here is what comes with it:

- multiplayer now counts headshots and kills correctly and attribute them correctly to players

- fixed a bug for player model rotation in multiplayer

- dino achivos can now be obtained also in multiplayer mode

- pausing a game now pauses all clients

- fixed a bug when assigning controls and pressing ESC would cause to unpause the game with controls window still visible

- fixed a bug with flashlight, now it is possible to assign a custom key 

- more graphic options for post processing effects (Sunshafts, Tonemapping, Fog etc.)

- additional slider to adjust FOV

- Weather is now correctly sync in multiplayer mode

- fixed bugs with weapon pickups when player could pickup more weapons than 3 and it was difficult to switch between them, now weapons are correctly assigned to weapon keys (1,2,3)

- possibility to change quality setting directly in game (FAST to BEAUTIFUL)

- adjusted lobby UI, with a dark skin so it is correctly visible on white backgrounds

Enjoy

ANPA.US

notes.title: Update Week 16
notes.notes:
*Warning - update might reset all your in-game data like unlocked guns, controls settings and xp. 

[h1] Multiplayer Update [/h1]
We're introducing new multiplayer framework on top of which we can build better gameplay. For now, it is classic death match, but it will serve as foundation for more content.

[b] Multiplayer is starting as a second executable, so if you experience low fps, try closing single player, it should get better [/b].

[h1] Textures Updates [/h1]
Too many to name them, but lots of textures were worked on to present themselves nicely in high resolution.

[h1] Maps Updates [/h1]
Canada gets Snow and palms go to Egypt

[h1] Zombie Update [/h1]
Zombie DLC gets new zombie model, you can take a look at the Zombie DLC screenshots.

[h1] Flashlight [/h1] 
As some of the scenes are night hunting, flashlight was the right choice to add and is a perfect companion to Zombie DLC.  You can enable flashlight with 'Q'.

[h1] Hitman path cutscenes [/h1]
Hitman character gets some new cutscenes in campaign, while Brute keeps his 2D artwork.

[h1] Bug fix [/h1]
Settings for 'Exploding Enemies' and 'HUD' will be now saved.
Other small bug fixes

Thank you for supporting us

notes.title: Update 1042788
notes.notes:
This update is focused on performance and "pain" points to make gameplay "smoother":

- another set of performance adjustements to base game and DLCs, this should be significant for lower spec PCs
- specific performance improvements to zombie DLC city maps
- zombie DLC updates to zombie movement 
- new feature to quickly draw weapons, first, second and third one with 1,2,3 keys (configurable under controls)
- you can now holster weapon
- you can now throw object when moving it (this is to prepare a foundation for objects that can be thrown at enemy to hurt them, in example bottle)
- added keys to select next and previous weapon (additionally to switch weapons with mouse scroll), configurable under controls
- minimap adjustements to instead render area in detail, minimap now is covering much wider range and focus on indicating enemy position
- fixed some shadow bugs
- ammo pickup fix, you will now only pickup ammo if you are not full and it will only count to currently selected weapon
- added two trailers with gameplay to store page

That's it for now. It is time to pave your way with blood. Dinosaur blood.

notes.title: Update 1022515
notes.notes:
Performance optimizations to survival mode when fending off large number of enemies, large part of code rewritten to store stats faster and eliminate the lag which caused slowdown to bullet firing leading to immediate death

New Strength stat, depending on your level you will have maximum number of weapons you can carry, indicated by Free Slots in Guns Menu. This will also impact the number of ammo you can carry into a level. You do not have to buy ammo anymore, you will be always loaded up to max when starting a level, depending on your strength stat and use pickups to get additional bullets, pickups will respawn after enemy is killed.

Thank you for your attention, now it is time to blow up something

New guns
AM Rifle and Shotgun for hitman character
Katana, bat and knife are now also available for brute character

New music soundtracks

Improvements
Redo sniper lens (removed the red dot) and increased their range
Improved moving mechanics
Improved messaging system
Improvements to UI
More quality settings in options: Bones, shadow cascades, distance, textures, aniso settings etc.
You can now move usable objects with M key (can be configured in Controls)

Changes
Max HP is now based on XP Level
Running requires Stamina regeneration which also depends on you XP level
You can get additional XP points for demolition and bodies dismembering 

Bugfix
Fixed a bug when getting stuck on dead bodies
Fixed a couple of bugs with ammo display system
Grenade key can be now configured in Controls 
Controls are now saved and persistent durting restarts

notes.title: Level-up/Rank System and Protagonist voice update
notes.notes:
As those were common requests asked by community, new update comes with level-up and rank system. Get XP for completing missions in campaign, scoring kills, surviving and nailing headshots, pave your way with blood to earn ultimate headsman rank. 

As demanded, protagonist voice gets an update, to become more mad than game itself. 

Hope you will like it, enjoy!

notes.title: Update 26 October
notes.notes:
After reading all the feedback how you miss the old armory (Wow that was surprising), the new ammo system and the old armory were merged, so now you can either exchange coins for bullets and load tons of ammo to start with or you can pickup ammo for free while playing. You can launch armory either from the menu before you start or during the play with "P" key. The Africa map now has water, which should give it a more cool look.

Trex is now much faster and deadly, so watch out and cover your back. 

Improved textures and shaders on some dinosaurs to get better look.

You can turn off videos going directly to options.

Thanks for all the feedback.

notes.title: Update v798693
notes.notes:
Changes:

- New map: Military Base

- Rewritten dinosaurs AI and moving mechanics. 
They avoid objects on their way, so not to get stuck. 
They climb or search for another path to get wherever you can get, so to limit camping on rocks, hills or in caves.
They are attracted by noise. 
They can attack from different angles. 

- Changes to survival mode. 
Enemies will get stronger with increasing wave number. 
Big dinosaurs require multiple headshots to put them down.

- Motion blur option in the menu

- Healing is disabled by default

- More languages support (Spanish and German)

Bug Fixes:

- Negative Bullets Fix
- Survival Cap Wave counting fixed 

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: New update v783733
notes.notes:
Fixes:
- Cursor locked inside the view while playing on map
- APO map fixed
- Minor fixes
- tweaks to dins behaviour, each dino has now different damage and hp, so in example raptors are fast and can kill you with one bite, but are easy to kill. On the opposite side, Triceratops or Brontosaurus is slower, has lower damage, but is harder to kill. 

Updates:
- New maps: ROCKIES, MOB. The most intense maps are Zombie, APO and MOB. 
- Removed killing limits on maps and survival mode
- sniper and crossbow upgrades moved to armory tab
- Tab upgrades renamed to MODES and Three gameplay modes available: 

1:1 Hunt - Hunting one specific target, some side actors can exist counted as "extra kill", to complete mission need to kill target, automatically loads next mission

1:ALL Hunt - All targets activated at once, will not attack until shoot/approached

1:ALL Survival - now you can activate survival mode from the store

You can still activate EXPLORER mode, where you can explore the map when the target is eliminated. 

NEXT UPDATE SCOPE
Achievements
